regime_context: The TSX detector shows broad, non-one-narrative rotation: Oil & Gas Producers lead with a thin durability bar (0.5, mixed hurst, breadth 0.357), while Consumer Staples & Retail and Big Banks show high durability, full breadth, and trend hurst just below the leader — a leadership handoff looks possible but is NOT confirmed. The validated leg (absolute-trend gate) helps on this market, so trend discipline is meaningful for drawdown avoidance, but track record shows dir_accuracy of only 0.313 across 147 calls, so conviction must default low.
emerging_watch: Watching Consumer Staples & Retail vs Oil & Gas Producers: if XST.TO closes above XEG.TO over a rolling 10-day window AND Oil & Gas breadth (0.357) does not improve, that would be a CONFIRMED leadership handoff to watch; retire the watch if Oil & Gas breadth rebounds above 0.6 and XEG regains a 3% lead over XST.

theses.subject: Consumer Staples & Retail
theses.thesis: Highest-quality trend leg in the ranks: score 0.932, durability 0.81 (strongest of all 16 themes), hurst 'trend', breadth 1.0 (every constituent participating), and crowding_z 0.83 but not crowded. It is eligible under the absolute-trend gate. The leader (Oil & Gas) has mixed hurst, thin durability 0.5, and weak breadth 0.357, suggesting its leadership is fragile while Consumer exhibits the exact durability/staying-power characteristics the validated gate rewards.
theses.dissent: Consumer Staples on the TSX is a defensive, rate-sensitive complex; if the macro backdrop (AI/tech + geopolitics dominating headlines, unscheduled share 0.68) shifts risk-on, defensives could lag cyclicals. Crowding_z 0.83 is the second-highest, so positioning is not clean.

falsifier.text: XST.TO lags XEG.TO by 4% over the next 20 trading days

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Same high-quality trend-leg profile as Consumer but in Financials: durability 0.8, hurst 'trend', breadth 1.0, crowding_z 0.75 (not crowded). Eligible under the gate. The TSX's Big Banks are a structurally heavy, liquidity-rich complex that historically shows stickier trend persistence than narrow commodity stories; this is a stay-power, not alpha, read.
theses.dissent: Banks are the most macro-correlated theme on the TSX; if the dominant macro narrative (geopolitics, inflation headlines) turns into a credit or rate shock, banks lead the downside. ZEB is also a crowded consensus long.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO underperforms XST.TO by 3% over the next 20 trading days

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: The leader by momentum rank (score 1.05) but with a thin durability bar (0.5), mixed hurst, and weak breadth (0.357) — only a third of constituents are participating. This is a fragile, narrow leadership. Guardrails explicitly forbid treating the rank as a buy list, and the weak breadth/durability means the staying-power leg does NOT support sizing into it. Avoid rather than overweight or fade.
theses.dissent: Oil & Gas is the confirmed leader with positive momentum score 1.05 and eligible true; abandoning a leading theme entirely risks missing continued strength. Energy can re-accelerate on a single supply/geopolitical headline (dominant macro theme includes geopolitics).

falsifier.text: XEG.TO gains 5% and breadth rises above 0.5 over the next 20 trading days
